g_policy.reason: The card is opt-in, the offer copy states the reward (3 Advanced reasoning mode answers today), 'Not now' leaves home unchanged, and the ad_fails field covers both no game available and an unconfirmed play.

g_no_cash.reason: The reward is 3 answers in a mode until midnight, which has no cash value and can't be withdrawn or transferred.

g_no_chat_content.reason: The trigger is the first app open after 3 or more days without a session by a non-subscriber, which is an app event and needs no chat content.

g_no_free_removal.reason: The idea adds a temporary sample and removes or caps nothing free ('removes nothing free: yes').

g_brand_safety.reason: The card sits in the header area of the Chats home (s01), which is rated safe, and is not inside a conversation or over a chat screen.

c1_revealed_value.reason: This is an existing_anchor proposal, and the paywall (s02.e03, ledger l02) charges for Advanced reasoning mode, so the app already charges for the resource being rewarded.

c2_evidence.reason: The 'what makes it work here' field says 'Luzia also plays a 15-second video ad before every fifth answer', but no mechanic or element in the product model shows any existing ad behavior (the '5' in the model is from 'Create up to 5 AI characters').

c4_protects_subscription.reason: The reward is only 3 answers that expire at midnight, so it is a sample that ends and the full feature stays behind the paid plans.

c5_moment.reason: The card appears on app open at the home screen, so it interrupts no task in progress and the user can dismiss it.

c6_fits_simula.reason: The unit is a play-to-earn game, the reward is shown only after the play is confirmed (an unconfirmed play gets 'That game didn't count'), and the trigger is a detectable app open after a 3+ day gap.

c7_specific.reason: It names Luzia+'s 'Advanced reasoning mode', the s01 home card position under the Luzia+ badge, and the 3-day trial button, so it is tied to this app.

other_concern: The 'higher-earning markets' cost rationale and the 'lapsing user' framing are predictions, not counted. Whether the app can gate answers to Advanced reasoning mode for a day is an assumption. The claim of existing ads should be removed or replaced with something supported.
